arStrings.szText: City’s still standing. He needs Temis and its people. At least, for now.
He’ll try to win over Queen Adreona first. He can’t get his way unless she’s on his side, or…silenced.
I need to find her, warn her. I helped her defend Skovos once before. With any luck, she'll listen to me.
"She’ll listen to me. She has to." - Trying to convince himself.  He know it won't be this easy.
Keep an eye out for the Hands. They seem to know what Mephisto’s planning—see if you can find out.
